scenario: LUNI.7.4 — `tolerance` is legal on unit-typed slots. For a celsius slot with `tolerance 0.5`, the literal is interpreted in the declared scale (celsius) and scale-converted to base. celsius has scale 1, so 0.5 celsius = 0.5 kelvin (the offset is dropped, since a tolerance is a difference, per LUNI.7.4). `compile_ok` does not observe the value. PATH PINNED: `dsc.lower`'s `tolerance_of`, through `dsc.quantity`'s `luni_7_4_tolerance_base`.
